https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/15/o.title_zh: 奥卢塞贡·米米科：一位东山再起的政治人物
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/15/o.body_zh: 2026年4月10日，奥卢塞贡·米米科博士辞去人民民主党（PDP）职务。5月14日，他在奥恩多西部加入进步大会党（APC）。那些“回跳”过的政治人物通常只折腾一次，米米科却养成了习惯。据一种统计，这是他不到20年内的第六次转换政党。2006年，他离开人民民主党，转入工党竞选奥恩多州州长。2007年，独立国家选举委员会宣布人民民主党的奥卢塞贡·阿加古获胜，但米米科于2009年2月在上诉法院夺回这一职位。2012年10月20日，他赢得连任，成为奥恩多州历史上首位完成两个完整任期的文官州长。他推出的“阿比耶”母婴医疗计划成为那段岁月的标志性成就。此后，“回跳”变得愈发艰难。2014年，他重返人民民主党，支持总统古德勒克·乔纳森；乔纳森于2015年败选，而他属意的接班人埃伊塔约·杰格德也在2016年州长选举中败给进步大会党的罗蒂米·阿克雷多卢。2018年，他组建巅峰工党，并在2019年奥恩多中部参议员选举中以56,628票名列遥远的第三。2021年，他重新加入人民民主党，而该党在2023年总统选举中败选。如今，他加入了进步大会党。米米科赞扬了尼日利亚教育贷款基金和州级治安机制。奥恩多州进步大会党主席科拉沃莱·巴巴通德称他的到来是“回归故里”；前议员约瑟夫·阿金拉贾表示，此举标志着米米科的政治阵营已彻底转入该党。这一“回跳”清晰可见。11月3日，米米科在拉各斯宣读了西南部进步大会党利益相关方会议的公报，会议决定齐声支持廷努布。前拉各斯州长巴巴通德·拉吉·法绍拉出席。10月17日，进步大会党党员、奥恩多州州长拉基·艾耶达蒂瓦在阿布贾庆祝自己72岁生日期间，以自己的名字重新命名了阿库雷的国际文化与活动中心，即“The Dome”。如今，读者只需关注西南部将在2027年为廷努布贡献多少选票。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层，同时充当抱负者与千禧一代探索新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。这份报纸是一项公共信托，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区议题，直至人与社会的十字路口。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: ‘AI speeding up drug design; next step is faster, cheaper medicines’: Siddhartha Mukherjee at HT Leadership Summit
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: Artificial intelligence is already cutting the time it takes to design new medicines from years to months, oncologist and author Siddhartha Mukherjee said on Saturday, but it must now make medicines faster, cheaper and better for patients if it is to prove its worth. “The single mitigating feature of AI is its capacity to produce transformative medicine,” Mukherjee, co-founder and chief executive of the drug-discovery company Manas AI, said at the 24th edition of the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 肿瘤科医生兼作家 Siddhartha Mukherjee 周六表示，人工智能已经把研发新药所需的时间从数年缩短至数月，但如果要证明其价值，它现在必须让药物对患者而言变得更快、更便宜、更好。Mukherjee 是药物研发公司 Manas AI 的联合创始人兼首席执行官。他是在《Hindustan Times》第24届领导力峰会上作出上述表示的。他表示：“人工智能唯一能够缓解问题的特点，是其研发变革性药物的能力。”
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: Artificial intelligence is already cutting the time it takes to design new medicines from years to months, oncologist and author Siddhartha Mukherjee said on Saturday, but it must now make medicines faster, cheaper and better for patients if it is to prove its worth. “The single mitigating feature of AI is its capacity to produce transformative medicine,” Mukherjee, co-founder and chief executive of the drug-discovery company Manas AI, said at the 24th edition of the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit. “Exhibit A of AI’s transformative power for human good is medicine. And if we fail in exhibit A, that creates an enormous problem for… whether we put up data centres or not, or what the value is of AI in various other industries.” The harder part, he said, is what happens after a molecule is designed: testing it in people and getting it approved, which have barely changed. AI could speed up clinical trials too, he said, but only with safeguards, so that medicines that do not work are not released to patients. India, he said, has a “historic opportunity” to show what AI can deliver if it reforms how new drugs are tested and approved. To lay out his case, Mukherjee explained how arduous drug discovery can be. Every medicine binds to a protein in the body, the way a key fits a lock, he explained. There are 10 to the power of 24 possible small-molecule keys, far too many to try one by one, so modern drug design starts with the lock: find a “keyhole” in the target protein, then build a molecule from scratch to fit it. This is where AI comes in, he said, citing his company Manas, which combines AI, “which is a neural system”, with what it calls “medicinal intelligence”: “the rules of physics and chemistry”. Illustrating how the technology can compress timelines for drug discovery, he cited the case of daraxonrasib, a pancreatic cancer drug. “It took a human researcher about ten years to find that keyhole,” Mukherjee said, adding: “It took our algorithm two hours to find that same keyhole.” That gain, he said, came “just from the keyhole finding module”. Manas sends 50 to 100 compounds at a time to Chinese chemical companies, which return test data in about three weeks. One molecule for a particular cancer, he said, “was generated completely without human intervention” and is “about two hundred times more potent than the competitor medicine that is available in the market”. Such work once took seven to eight years, he said; it now takes three to four months. “But the back end, which is where we actually put these molecules into humans and test them against diseases, is still very much the same,” he said. “More medicines are emerging very rapidly from our engines, and then they’re getting blocked at the pinch point.” AI does not change what he called the “phase two coin flip”, the chance that a drug fails in mid-stage trials. In a Q&A with HT’s R Sukumar, Mukherjee was asked whether medicine was “too hung up on the accepted model of clinical testing”, and if there is a case to radically overhaul that, given the computing power AI now offers. “Well, the quick answer is, yes, of course, there’s a radical way to change it,” Mukherjee said, but added that the question was whether it should be changed. Medicine invented the randomised, blinded clinical trial “essentially to overcome human bias”, he said. “We want to see our medicine succeed.” Trials could be sped up by using historical or simulated data as the comparison group, he said, but he warned of “BIBO, bias in, bias out”. Relying on such data alone, he said, risks “unleashing medicines into the world which actually don’t work or don’t work as well as we think they do”. He suggested conditional approval, which he said the Europeans are trying “quite a lot”: a medicine is approved after a rapid trial, the trial continues with proper controls, and the approval can be withdrawn after two or three years. He called India’s chance to change the economics of medicine the punchline of his talk. “Of all countries in the world, China and I truly believe India, with appropriate regulatory and technological reform,” can reverse a long trend in which, he said, the “number of medicines approved over time has actually been decreasing… and the cost of each medicine has been increasing”. “We have a historic opportunity in this country,” he said. India can make the difference in testing, he said, “because we have a highly educated population of physicians, physician scientists”. He cited Immuneel, a Bengaluru cell-therapy company he said he launched about three years ago with Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw. Its therapy for blood cancers first used binders borrowed from other countries. “But for the first time, we have created a synthetic binder using AI,” he said. He described the new molecules, made with Manas, as “first in class, first in kind, made in India”. Also Read | Medicine is AI’s real test, and India has a historic opportunity: Siddhartha Mukherjee “The medicine that costs $500,000 in the United States is now being sold. It’s now a commercial product, is being sold for $35,000 in India,” he said. “The human resources and the human capital which is present here is really the answer,” he said, to speeding up what he called “the second half of the equation”. Mukherjee, born in New Delhi and trained at Stanford, Oxford and Harvard, is on leave from Columbia University’s medical faculty. He won the 2011 Pulitzer Prize for General Nonfiction for The Emperor of All Maladies, his history of cancer
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: “人工智能正在加快药物设计；下一步是研发更快捷、更便宜的药物”：西达artha·慕克吉在HT领导力峰会上表示
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh:
肿瘤科医生、作家 Siddhartha Mukherjee 周六表示，人工智能已经将新药设计所需的时间从数年缩短至数月，但如果要证明自身价值，它现在必须让药物研发更快、更便宜，并为患者带来更好的疗效。Mukherjee 是药物研发公司 Manas AI 的联合创始人兼首席执行官。他在第24届 Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 上说：“人工智能唯一能够缓解问题的特点，是它能够催生具有变革意义的药物。人工智能造福人类、推动变革的第一个例证就是医学。如果我们连第一个例证都做不到，就会给……带来一个巨大的问题，不论我们是否建设数据中心，也不论人工智能在其他各行业的价值究竟是什么。”

他说，更困难的部分是在分子设计完成之后：如何在人群中开展测试并获得批准，而这方面几乎没有改变。他表示，人工智能也能加快临床试验，但必须设置保障措施，避免把无效药物交给患者。他说，印度拥有“历史性机遇”，如果改革新药测试和审批方式，就能展示人工智能能够带来什么。

为说明自己的观点，Mukherjee 解释了药物研发有多么艰巨。他解释道，每种药物都会与人体内的一种蛋白质结合，就像钥匙与锁相配。可能的分子小钥匙有10的24次方种，数量太多，无法逐一尝试，因此现代药物设计要从锁开始：先在目标蛋白质上找到一个“锁孔”，再从头设计一个与之匹配的分子。他说，人工智能正是在这里发挥作用。他以自己创办的 Manas 为例，这家公司将人工智能——“一种神经系统”——与所谓的“药物研发智慧”结合起来，也就是“物理学和化学的规则”。

为了说明这项技术如何压缩药物研发周期，他提到了胰腺癌药物 daraxonrasib 的案例。Mukherjee 说：“一名人类研究人员花了大约十年时间才找到那个锁孔。”他补充道：“我们的算法只用了两个小时就找到了同一个锁孔。”他说，这一效率提升“仅仅来自锁孔寻找模块”。

Manas 每次会向中国化工企业发送50至100种化合物，这些企业大约在三周后返回测试数据。他说，针对某种特定癌症的一个分子“完全是在没有人类干预的情况下生成的”，其“效力约为市场上现有竞争药物的两百倍”。他说，这类工作过去需要七至八年，如今只需三至四个月。

“但后端环节，也就是我们真正把这些分子用于人体、并针对疾病进行测试的部分，仍然基本没有改变，”他说。“我们的引擎正在非常迅速地产出更多药物，随后这些药物却在瓶颈处受阻。”人工智能并没有改变他所说的“二期掷硬币”，也就是药物在中期试验中失败的可能性。

在与 HT 的 R Sukumar 进行问答时，有人问 Mukherjee，医学界是否“过于拘泥于公认的临床测试模式”，以及鉴于人工智能如今提供的算力，是否有必要彻底改革这一模式。Mukherjee 说：“嗯，快速回答是，是的，当然存在一种彻底改变它的办法。”但他补充说，问题在于是否应该改变这种模式。他说，现代医学发明随机、双盲临床试验，“本质上是为了克服人类偏见”。“我们希望看到自己的药物取得成功。”

他说，可以利用历史数据或模拟数据作为对照组来加快试验，但他警告要警惕“BIBO，即输入带有偏差，输出也会带有偏差”。他说，仅依赖这类数据，可能会“把实际上无效、或者效果没有我们认为那么好的药物释放到世界中”。他建议实行有条件批准，并表示欧洲人正在“相当多地”尝试这种做法：药物经过快速试验后获得批准，试验在适当控制条件下继续进行，批准可在两三年后撤回。

他把印度改变药物经济学的机会称为演讲的压轴结论。他说：“在全世界所有国家中，真正相信中国和印度在实施适当的监管与技术改革后，能够扭转一种长期趋势的国家并不多。”据他所说，这种趋势是“一段时间内获批药物的数量实际上一直在下降……而每种药物的成本一直在上升”。

他说：“这个国家拥有历史性机遇。”他说，印度能够在药物测试方面发挥决定性作用，“因为我们拥有一支受教育程度很高的医生和医学科学家队伍”。他提到 Immuneel，这是一家班加罗尔的细胞治疗公司；他说，大约三年前，他与 Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw 共同创办了这家公司。该公司用于治疗血液癌症的疗法最初采用了来自其他国家的结合剂。

“但我们第一次利用人工智能创造出了合成结合剂，”他说。他把与 Manas 合作制造的新分子称为“同类首创、同类首创、诞生于印度”。另请阅读｜医学才是人工智能真正的考验，而印度拥有历史性机遇：Siddhartha Mukherjee

他说：“这种药物在美国售价50万美元，如今已经开始销售。它现在已成为商业产品，在印度的售价为35,000美元。”他说：“这里拥有的人力资源和人力资本，才是真正的答案。”这有助于加快他所说的“等式的后半部分”。

Mukherjee 出生于新德里，曾在 Stanford、Oxford 和 Harvard 受过训练，目前暂停在 Columbia University 医学院任教。他凭借癌症史著作 The Emperor of All Maladies 获得了2011年普利策非虚构作品奖。

https://theopenpress.in/article/gunmen-a.body: Armed men have killed at least 38 civilians in an ambush in western Niger near the borders with Burkina Faso and Mali, local sources said on Friday. The attack targeted residents of the village of Tillim who were heading early on Thursday to a weekly market in the town of Tera in the restive Tillaberi region. Escorted by members of a local self-defence group, the villagers fell into an ambush by unidentified armed men, a former elected official said. He said 37 people were killed on the spot and another succumbed to their wounds a day later. The dead included 11 members of the self-defence escort, 20 men and seven women, according to local accounts. A resident of Tera said the attack killed 37 people including women and children, and residents said children were also among the casualties. The gunmen had not been identified, and no group had claimed the attack in the reporting available on Friday. There was no immediate official statement from Niger's government. One unconfirmed report attributed the attack to the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara, a claim that has not been confirmed by other sources. Niger's Tillaberi region, on the borders with Mali and Burkina Faso, has become the epicentre of jihadist attacks in the central Sahel. Niger, ruled by a military junta since a 2023 coup, is battling violence by jihadists linked to Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State group. The Islamic State in the Greater Sahara has been competing for territorial expansion across the Sahel with Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin, an extremist group linked to Al-Qaeda. Both groups have targeted civilians, security forces and local self-defence groups in the tri-border zone. Last year, Tillaberi became the deadliest region in the central Sahel where civilians were the most targeted, according to the conflict monitor ACLED. The region hosts just under half of the 450,000 people registered as displaced in Niger, according to the United Nations. The toll from Thursday's ambush rests on local sources and has not been confirmed by officials, so the figures may change as more information reaches Tera. Market convoys in the region routinely travel under escort because of the risk of attack on the roads. Gunmen ambushed a convoy of villagers from Tillim travelling under escort to a weekly market in Tera, in the Tillaberi region, killing 37 people on the spot. Another victim died of wounds a day later, taking the toll to at least 38. The dead included 11 self-defence fighters, 20 men and seven women, according to local accounts. Residents said women and children were among the casualties. The gunmen have not been identified and no group has claimed the attack. One unconfirmed report attributed it to the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara, a claim that has not been confirmed by other sources. Tillaberi, on Niger's borders with Mali and Burkina Faso, has become the epicentre of jihadist attacks in the central Sahel. Last year it was the deadliest region in the central Sahel for civilians, according to the conflict monitor ACLED. https://punchng.com/ogun-to-host-tech-su.body: T echnology stakeholders and professionals in the digital ecosystem will converge on Abeokuta, the Ogun State capital, for the seventh edition of the Ogun Digital Summit, where calls for a dedicated Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy are expected to feature prominently. The convener of the summit, Victor Adeleye, in a statement on Saturday, said the event will hold from November 25 to 27, 2026. Adeleye, a technology entrepreneur and ecosystem builder, said a dedicated ministry would provide the institutional framework to harness the state’s technology potential, support start-ups, and attract private sector investment. He noted that the state possessed the advantages to emerge as a major technology destination, citing its concentration of educational institutions, proximity to Lagos, industrial activities, and growing youth population. Adeleye, however, stressed the need for deliberate policies and institutional support to translate these advantages into economic opportunities. Ogun ADC rejects caretaker committee, parallel leadership Abiodun rallies support for N600m Ogun palace project Nigeria needs 700,000 houses annually to tackle 28m deficit – Mortgage bank chair According to him, the proposed ministry would oversee broadband infrastructure, digital skills development, start-up support, technology investment, e-governance, and innovation policies. He added that it would strengthen collaboration between the state government, the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, private investors, and other relevant agencies. Adeleye said the initiative would help attract technology companies, create employment opportunities for young professionals, and provide a supportive environment for local entrepreneurs. He also called for the expansion of digital development beyond Abeokuta to other major towns, including Ijebu-Ode, Sagamu, and Ota. Olufemi Adediran

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: Falana urges Tinubu govt to prosecute sponsors of electoral violence ahead of 2027
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: Human rights lawyer Femi Falana has urged the federal government to prosecute politicians who sponsor electoral violence, warning that attacks on political opponents and intimidation of voters threaten the credibility of the 2027 general elections.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 人权律师费米·法拉纳敦促联邦政府起诉资助选举暴力的政治人物，并警告称，袭击政治对手和恐吓选民会威胁2027年大选的可信度。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Human rights lawyer Femi Falana has urged the federal government to prosecute politicians who sponsor electoral violence, warning that attacks on political opponents and intimidation of voters threaten the credibility of the 2027 general elections. Mr Falana, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN), said the government must go beyond arresting suspected political thugs and hold accountable those who recruit, finance and arm them. He made the call at the sixth Frontier Discourse Annual Public Lecture Series and Awards organised by Pacesetter Frontiers Magazine at Merit House, Maitama, Abuja. The statement was shared with PREMIUM TIMES on Saturday. In his keynote address, titled “Barrel to Ballot: The Naturalisation of Violence, Nigeria’s Polity and its Democratic Circus,” Mr Falana stated that political violence was rooted in deeper problems of governance, accountability and the failure to protect citizens’ rights. “As the 2027 elections approach, the State must protect lives, enforce electoral laws and punish those who sponsor or perpetrate political violence, irrespective of status or political connections,” he said. He accused politicians of recruiting unemployed youths, arming them and supplying them with money and drugs to attack opponents, disrupt political meetings and intimidate voters. The warning comes amid reports of attacks on political figures and their supporters in different parts of the country. The African Centre for Security, Governance and Development (CentreSGD) reported 70 physical election-related attacks across 19 states and the Federal Capital Territory between 1 January and 27 October 2026. It said 27 people were killed in 20 of the incidents. The organisation also cited a Yiaga Africa survey which found that 61 per cent of Nigerians feared violence could prevent them from voting in the 2027 elections. Mr Falana referred to the 30 October attack on African Action Congress presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore and members of his entourage in Ado-Ekiti, Ekiti State. The incident generated conflicting accounts. While Mr Sowore described it as an attack by armed men, the Ekiti State Police Command said it was an altercation with another group at a restaurant. Mr Sowore disputed the police account and questioned the identity of those arrested. The lawyer also cited the attack on the convoy of Peter Obi, presidential candidate of the Nigerian Democratic Congress, in Calabar, Cross River State. Police said suspected hoodlums armed with machetes and sticks attacked the convoy around Watt Market Roundabout on 4 November. They later announced the arrest of a 27-year-old suspect, Victor Duke, while investigations continued. Mr Falana also mentioned attacks on All Progressives Congress leaders in Kebbi, Katsina and Nasarawa states, saying the incidents showed that no political party had a monopoly on political violence. He noted that political competition should be determined by ideas and persuasion rather than intimidation and the use of force. He urged the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to establish a dedicated unit to investigate and prosecute electoral offenders. Mr Falana advised the commission to obtain reports from the police and other security agencies, investigate alleged violations and take offenders to court. “I am suggesting that INEC should have a prosecution unit with a view to getting reports from the police and other security agencies about electoral offences and then take them to court,” he said. He also criticised the National Assembly for failing to implement the recommendation for an Electoral Offences Commission, arguing that the absence of an effective prosecution mechanism had allowed politicians involved in electoral violence to escape accountability. The lawyer raised concerns about what he described as restrictions on opposition parties’ access to campaign platforms. He alleged that some state governments demanded between N150 million and N200 million for political billboards, depending on the office being contested. He stated that the charges could make it difficult for opposition parties to campaign and give incumbent politicians an unfair advantage. Mr Falana said the country already had constitutional and electoral provisions prohibiting the use of violence and armed groups for political purposes. He cited Section 227 of the Nigerian constitution, which prohibits the establishment and maintenance of private political armies and other organisations equipped to use physical force or coercion to pursue political objectives. He said the prohibition applied regardless of the names given to such groups, including political vanguards, enforcement teams and campaign protection groups. He also referred to Section 228(a) of the Constitution and Section 78 of the Electoral Act 2026, which provide for sanctions relating to violations of the constitutional prohibition. Under the Electoral Act, Section 95 requires the police to provide adequate security for political rallies and processions, while Section 96 prohibits the organisation and use of groups for political force or coercion. Section 97 also prohibits threats of force or violence intended to compel support for or opposition to a political party or candidate. Mr Falana further cited Sections 120, 129, 130 and 132, which address disorderly conduct at political meetings and elections, possession of offensive weapons intended to intimidate voters, and the use of force or threats to interfere with citizens’ right to vote. He explained that the failure to enforce these provisions, particularly against those who finance and organise political violence, remained a major problem. “The problem is the gap between the law in the statute book and the law in operation,” he said. He criticised the practice of arresting suspected political thugs while their alleged sponsors continued to enjoy political protection. The concerns are not new. A joint election observation report by the National Democratic Institute and the International Republican Institute documented 586 election-related violence incidents and 348 fatalities during the 2023 election cycle. The observers also reported attacks on INEC offices, personnel and electoral materials and raised concerns about the limited accountability for political actors involved in electoral violence. Mr Falana said the government had a constitutional obligation to protect citizens, citing Section 14(2)(b) of the Constitution, which identifies the security and welfare of the people as the primary purpose of government. He also referred to Sections 33, 34 and 35, which guarantee the rights to life, dignity of the human person and personal liberty. He urged Nigerians to reject vote-selling, electoral manipulation and incitement, while demanding accountability from political office holders. He said democracy should not be measured only by the conduct of elections but also by whether citizens could participate freely and hold elected officials accountable. “We must end political violence, dismantle impunity and restore the ballot to its rightful owners,” he stated. “The ballot must be more powerful than the barrel. That is the democracy Nigeria deserves and must collectively build.”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 法拉纳敦促蒂努布政府起诉2027年选举前煽动选举暴力的幕后指使者和资助者
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 人权律师费米·法拉纳敦促联邦政府起诉资助选举暴力的政治人物，并警告称，袭击政治对手和恐吓选民的行径威胁着2027年大选的可信度。尼日利亚资深律师（SAN）法拉纳先生说，政府不能仅仅逮捕涉嫌充当政治打手的人，还必须追究那些招募、资助并武装他们的人员的责任。他是在Pacesetter Frontiers Magazine于阿布贾迈塔梅Merit House举办的第六届Frontier Discourse年度公开讲座系列暨颁奖活动上提出这一要求的。该声明于星期六分享给PREMIUM TIMES。在题为“Barrel to Ballot: The Naturalisation of Violence, Nigeria’s Polity and its Democratic Circus”的主旨演讲中，法拉纳先生指出，政治暴力根源在于治理、问责以及未能保护公民权利等更深层的问题。他说：“随着2027年选举临近，国家必须保护生命、执行选举法律，并惩罚那些资助或实施政治暴力的人，无论其身份地位或政治关系如何。”他指控政治人物招募失业青年，为其配备武器，并提供资金和毒品，唆使他们袭击对手、扰乱政治集会和恐吓选民。发出这一警告之际，多地传出政治人物及其支持者遭袭的消息。非洲安全、治理与发展中心（CentreSGD）报告称，2026年1月1日至10月27日期间，19个州及联邦首都领地共发生70起与选举有关的实体袭击事件，其中20起事件共造成27人死亡。该组织还引用了Yiaga Africa的一项调查，结果显示，61%的尼日利亚人担心暴力可能使他们无法参加2027年大选投票。法拉纳先生提及了10月30日非洲行动大会 presidential候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷及其随行人员在埃基蒂州阿多埃基蒂遭袭一事。事件存在不同说法。索沃雷先生称，袭击者是武装人员；埃基蒂州警察指挥部则表示，这是在一家餐馆与另一团体发生的冲突。索沃雷先生对警方的说法提出异议，并质疑被捕者的身份。这名律师还提到尼日利亚民主大会总统候选人彼得·奥比的车队在克鲁罗河州卡拉巴遭袭。警方称，11月4日左右，疑似携带砍刀和棍棒的地痞在Watt Market环岛附近袭击了车队，随后宣布逮捕一名27岁的嫌疑人维克托·杜克，调查仍在继续。法拉纳先生还提到全进步大会党领导人在凯比州、卡齐纳州和纳萨拉瓦州遭袭，称这些事件表明，没有任何政党垄断政治暴力。他指出，政治竞争应由理念和说服力来决定，而不是依靠恐吓和使用暴力。他敦促独立国家选举委员会（INEC）设立专门部门，调查并起诉选举违法者。法拉纳先生建议，该委员会应获取警方及其他安全机构的报告，调查涉嫌违法行为，并将违法者送上法庭。他说：“我建议INEC设立一个起诉部门，获取警方及其他安全机构关于选举违法行为的报告，然后将违法者送上法庭。”他还批评国民议会未能落实设立选举违法委员会的建议，认为缺乏有效的起诉机制，使参与选举暴力的政治人物得以逃避问责。这名律师对所谓限制反对党使用竞选平台表示担忧。他声称，一些州政府会根据竞选职位不同，要求支付1.5亿至2亿奈拉不等，用于政治广告牌。他表示，这些收费可能使反对党难以开展竞选，并让在任政治人物获得不公平的优势。法拉纳先生说，该国宪法和选举法律已经禁止为政治目的使用暴力和武装团体。他援引了尼日利亚宪法第227条，该条禁止建立和维持私人政治军队及其他配备武力或胁迫手段以追求政治目标的组织。他说，这一禁令无论相关团体使用何种名称均适用，包括政治先锋队、执行团队和竞选护卫团。他还提及《宪法》第228(a)条和《2026年选举法》第78条，这些条款规定了违反宪法禁令的制裁措施。根据《选举法》，第95条要求警方为政治集会和游行提供充分安全保护，第96条禁止组织和利用团体实施政治武力或胁迫，第97条则禁止以武力或暴力相威胁，意图迫使人们支持或反对某一政党或候选人。法拉纳先生进一步援引了第120条、第129条、第130条和第132条，这些条款涉及政治集会和选举中的扰乱行为、持有旨在恐吓选民的进攻性武器，以及使用武力或威胁干涉公民投票权。他解释道，未能执行这些规定，尤其是未能追究资助和组织政治暴力者的责任，仍是一个重大问题。他说：“问题在于，成文法中的法律与实际执行的法律之间存在落差。”他批评只逮捕涉嫌政治打手、而让其所谓资助者继续享有政治保护的做法。这些担忧并非新近出现。国家民主研究所与国际共和研究所联合发布的选举观察报告记录了2023年选举周期内的586起选举相关暴力事件和348人死亡。观察员还报告了针对INEC办公室、工作人员和选举材料的袭击，并对参与选举暴力的政治行为者问责有限表示担忧。法拉纳先生说，政府负有保护公民的宪法义务，并援引了《宪法》第14(2)(b)条，该条将人民的安全和福祉列为政府的首要目的。他还提及第33条、第34条和第35条，这些条款保障生命权、人的人格尊严和个人自由。他敦促尼日利亚人抵制出售选票、操纵选举和煽动暴力行为，同时要求公职人员承担责任。他说，衡量民主不能只看选举的进行情况，还要看公民能否自由参与并追究民选官员的责任。他表示：“我们必须终结政治暴力，打破有罪不罚的局面，把选票交还给它真正的主人。选票的力量必须大于枪炮。这正是尼日利亚理应享有并由全体共同建设的民主。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-price-an.title: The Price and promise of a solitary monetary policy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-price-an.summary: Read against the Plaza and Louvre Accords, the two outcomes are not contradictory: they are the price of stabilising a currency alone. In 2025, the Bank of Ghana (BoG) accomplished something of extraordinary monetary significance. It is best understood as a monetary tribute: the price a post-crisis financial system, already distorted by the DDEP, exacts for withdrawing the excess liquidity that crisis-era monetary financing created.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-price-an.summary_zh: 结合《广场协议》和《卢浮宫协议》来看，这两个结果并不矛盾：它们是单独稳定一种货币所要付出的代价。2025年，加纳央行（BoG）完成了一件具有非凡货币意义的事情。最好将其理解为一种货币上的进贡：受到外汇债务兑换计划（DDEP）扭曲的危机后金融体系，为收回危机时期货币融资所造成的过剩流动性而索取的代价。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-price-an.body: In 2025, the cedi posted its first annual gain against the US dollar in more than three decades, while the Bank of Ghana posted a combined loss of GHS 34.95 billion. Read against the Plaza and Louvre Accords, the two outcomes are not contradictory: they are the price of stabilising a currency alone. In 2025, the Bank of Ghana (BoG) accomplished something of extraordinary monetary significance. The cedi appreciated by 40.7 per cent against the US dollar, its first annual gain in more than three decades and, on IMF data, the strongest performance of any African currency. Headline inflation, which had peaked at 54.1 per cent in late 2022, fell to 5.4 per cent by year-end, and gross international reserves rose to a record US$13.83 billion. The same year produced large losses on the Bank’s balance sheet. Its audited statements, released on 30 April 2026, show a net operating loss of GHS 15.63 billion, up from GHS 9.49 billion in 2024, and a further loss of GHS 19.32 billion in other comprehensive income. The combined loss of GHS 34.95 billion pushed cumulative negative equity to about GHS 96.3 billion. Severed from their context, these figures read as catastrophe. Situated within the history of coordinated exchange-rate statecraft, they read as something else entirely: the quantified cost of macroeconomic stewardship in the absence of multilateral burden-sharing. The modern international monetary system rests on a structural paradox. Capital moves across borders in quantities that dwarf the reserves of any single monetary authority, yet central-bank mandates remain resolutely national, so that misalignments are increasingly absorbed on central-bank balance sheets. At decisive moments, the major economies answered such misalignments with coordinated intervention, whose efficacy is usually traced to the signalling channel. A unilateral stabiliser lacks that multilateral credibility by definition. Yet Ghana’s outcomes suggest that unilateral intervention can replicate much of what coordination achieved, provided it is sufficiently aggressive, sufficiently sustained and anchored by credible external surveillance. The price is borne in full by one institution and recorded with brutal clarity on its balance sheet. The Plaza Accord of 22 September 1985 remains the defining act of post-Bretton Woods monetary diplomacy. By the spring of that year, the dollar had appreciated by roughly 44 percent against a trade-weighted basket over five years. Its causes were well understood: American fiscal expansion, colliding with a tight Federal Reserve, had drawn in capital through real interest-rate differentials, while a widening trade deficit fed protectionist pressure in Congress. The finance ministers and central-bank governors of the G-5 (the United States, Japan, West Germany, France and the United Kingdom) responded with a communiqué of studied ambiguity but unmistakable intent. The dollar was overvalued, and they would cooperate to encourage its orderly decline through concerted intervention. Their dollar sales, about US$10 billion in the following weeks, were modest by modern standards. Their power lay in the signal. Sterilised intervention cannot durably move exchange rates through portfolio-balance effects alone; its force derives from the credible public commitment of several sovereigns, each bearing reputational and financial cost. That jointness, constitutive rather than merely logistical, is precisely what a unilateral stabiliser cannot reproduce. In the event, Plaza overachieved: by early 1987, the trade-weighted dollar had fallen by about 40 percent from its peak, and an excessively weak dollar had displaced the original problem. The Louvre Accord of February 1987 reversed the objective, seeking to halt the slide within informal reference ranges. The episode showed that defending an equilibrium is structurally different from engineering a correction. Defence requires continuous sterilisation, sustained liquidity management and interest-rate differentials wide enough to deter speculation, and each carries a direct cost to the central-bank balance sheet. The participating central banks absorbed those costs collectively. Neither communiqué said who would pay. Exchange-rate operations are quasi-fiscal in character, redistributing income and imposing costs much as explicit taxation or public expenditure would. IMF staff research notes that such losses are met from equity buffers where these suffice, or otherwise through government transfers; either way, they are fiscal costs. The G-5, with deep fiscal capacity and implicit mutual backstops, socialised those costs across their treasuries. Ghana had no equivalent mechanism. Between 2022 and 2025, the BoG performed the correction-and-defence function of the Plaza–Louvre model entirely alone. It did so under a US$3 billion IMF Extended Credit Facility, in the aftermath of the most severe domestic debt restructuring in Ghana’s post-independence history, and against a legacy of fiscal dominance and structural excess liquidity. When advanced economies tighten aggressively, capital flight and dollar strength exert depreciatory pressure on African currencies, feeding imported inflation and swelling the cost of foreign-currency debt. The cedi lacks the reserve status that the yen and the deutschmark enjoyed in the 1980s, yet the Bank of Ghana Act, 2002 (Act 612) mandates price stability and support for a stable path of the cedi. The Bank must therefore intervene alone, trading institutional equity for currency stability. The Mundell–Fleming trilemma holds that no country can combine a fixed exchange rate, free capital mobility and monetary independence, and Hélène Rey argues that the global financial cycle reduces it to a dilemma. Neither fully captures the BoG’s position. The Bank faced a quadrilemma, in which four objectives could not all be maintained together: Against the structural excess liquidity associated with the Domestic Debt Exchange Programme (DDEP), large policy-driven losses were not merely probable but arithmetically inevitable. Ghana was not choosing between the corners of the impossible trinity; it was attempting to occupy three adjacent policy positions at once. The losses were the clearing mechanism through which that overdetermined system resolved its contradictions, with the balance sheet as absorber of last resort. Credibility came, paradoxically, from an external constraint. The sequence of IMF programme reviews, each demanding performance on inflation, reserves and fiscal targets, formed a serial credibility mechanism that the BoG could not have generated on its own. For central banks without the geopolitical capital of G-5 membership, IMF conditionality, deployed as a substitute commitment device, is thus the closest functional equivalent of multilateral coordination. It carries sovereignty costs, but it can deliver outcomes comparable in quality, if not in mechanism, to coordinated intervention. The headline loss is not a homogeneous expression of failure. It arose from three structurally distinct mechanisms. The first and largest is the cost of open market operations (OMO), which reached GHS 16.73 billion in 2025, nearly double the GHS 8.60 billion of 2024. It is best understood as a monetary tribute: the price a post-crisis financial system, already distorted by the DDEP, exacts for withdrawing the excess liquidity that crisis-era monetary financing created. Launched in December 2022, the DDEP required domestic bondholders to swap existing securities for longer-dated, lower-yield bonds. It imposed impairments of about GHS 48 billion on the BoG’s holdings, including a 50 percent haircut on non-marketable instruments, and cut its annual interest income by about GHS 13 billion until the affected instruments mature. The restructuring also steered commercial-bank liquidity into BoG money-market instruments, which offered attractive short-term returns amid still-elevated policy rates. By 2025, the OMO book stood at about GHS 93.6 billion, at rates between 18 and 28 percent. Without sterilisation, that liquidity would have fed inflation and depreciation and unwound gains already won. The OMO bill was the price of not losing them. The second, GHS 9.05 billion in losses on gold transactions, is the most mischaracterised component. Under its domestic gold-purchase programme, run alongside the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), the Bank bought locally mined gold from artisanal and small-scale miners in cedis and converted it into reserves. The loss arises because the cedi acquisition cost, recognised at purchase, exceeds the carrying value at which the gold enters the balance sheet. It is a timing mismatch, not a destruction of value. At the end of 2025 the Bank still held about 18.6 tonnes of gold, worth roughly three times the loss attributed to the programme, having sold some 19 tonnes at a realised profit. The strategic logic reaches beyond reserve accumulation. By requiring domestic gold to be settled in cedis before export, Ghana’s gold-governance architecture routed foreign-exchange earnings through official channels, reduced illicit financial flows and gave the BoG a continuous source of dollar liquidity for intervention. The programme was instrumental in lifting gross international reserves from US$9.11 billion to US$13.83 billion. The third is an appreciation paradox, in which Ghana’s most celebrated achievement generated large losses. When a central bank holds foreign-currency reserves and its own currency appreciates, the local-currency value of those reserves falls mechanically. A US$1 billion holding is worth GHS 17 billion at 17 cedis to the dollar, but only GHS 10 billion at 10. In 2025, the cedi’s rise produced GHS 5.47 billion in revaluation losses in the operating account and GHS 19.32 billion in other comprehensive income. This is a structural feature of central-bank balance sheets in small open economies, not a policy error. The Bundesbank and the Bank of Japan experienced exactly this effect after Plaza, as their dollar sales lifted the deutschmark and the yen. The economic substance is structurally equivalent; only the distribution of the burden differs. The effect is also reversible, as Governor Johnson Pandit Asiama has noted. By May 2026, the cedi had weakened to about GHS 11.5 to the dollar from the GHS 10.4 at which the 2025 accounts were struck, the signature of a translation effect rather than a real depletion of reserves. Ghana’s experience is far from unique, and the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) has been emphatic that losses and negative equity do not in themselves impair a central bank’s capacity to operate. The European Central Bank (ECB) lost €7.94 billion in 2024 by paying elevated interest on banks’ reserves while earning low yields on legacy bonds, a structure that closely mirrors the BoG’s OMO costs. The ECB carries these losses forward against future profits, with no recapitalisation requirement. The Czech National Bank (CNB) is the closest precedent for Ghana’s 2025 position. Between November 2013 and April 2017, it prevented the koruna from appreciating beyond CZK 27 per euro to avert deflation, accumulating reserves on a massive scale. When the floor was removed, the koruna appreciated, the koruna value of its euro assets fell, and negative equity persisted for years without any impairment of its inflation-targeting functions. The parallel is imperfect, given the CNB’s European context, but its lesson translates: revaluation losses left by successful exchange-rate management do not compromise the institution that incurs them. Elsewhere, the Federal Reserve carries its losses as a deferred asset against future remittances to the Treasury, while HM Treasury indemnifies the Bank of England’s losses on gilt sales.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-price-an.title_zh: 单一货币政策的代价与承诺

2025年，塞地首次实现对美元三十多年来首次年度上涨，而加纳央行（BoG）录得合计亏损349.5亿加纳塞地。对照《广场协议》和《卢浮宫协议》，这两种结果并不矛盾：这是仅靠一个机构稳定货币所付出的代价。

2025年，加纳央行完成了一件具有非凡货币意义的事情。塞地对美元升值40.7%，创下三十多年来首次年度涨幅；根据国际货币基金组织（IMF）数据，这也是所有非洲货币中表现最强的。总体通胀率从2022年末的峰值54.1%降至年末的5.4%，国际储备总额升至创纪录的138.3亿美元。

同年，该行资产负债表出现巨额亏损。其于2026年4月30日发布的经审计财务报表显示，净经营亏损为156.3亿加纳塞地，高于2024年的94.9亿加纳塞地，其他综合收益另有193.2亿加纳塞地亏损。合计349.5亿加纳塞地的亏损使累计负权益增至约963亿加纳塞地。脱离具体背景来看，这些数字仿佛意味着灾难；但放在协调汇率国家艺术的演进历程中，它们呈现出的含义完全不同：在缺乏多边分担的情况下，实施宏观经济管理所付出的可量化成本。

现代国际货币体系建立在一种结构性悖论之上。资本跨境流动的规模远超任何单一货币当局所持有的储备，而中央银行的职责授权却依然坚决以国家为单位，因此，失配越来越多地由中央银行资产负债表吸收。在关键时刻，主要经济体通过协调干预来应对此类失配，其成效通常被认为来自信号传递渠道。单边稳定工具根据定义便缺乏这种多边公信力。

然而，加纳的结果表明，只要力度足够大、持续时间足够长，并以可信的外部监督为锚，单边干预可以复制协调行动所实现的许多成果。代价由一个机构全额承担，并毫不留情地记录在其资产负债表上。

1985年9月22日签订的《广场协议》仍是布雷顿森林体系后货币外交的标志性行动。到当年春季，美元兑贸易加权一篮子货币在五年内累计升值约44%。其成因已得到充分理解：美国财政扩张与美联储紧缩政策相冲突，通过实际利率差吸引资本流入；与此同时，贸易逆差扩大，在国会中助长了保护主义压力。

G-5（美国、日本、西德、法国和英国）的财政部长和央行行长发布了一份措辞刻意含混、但意图无可置疑的公报：美元估值过高，各方将合作，通过协同干预推动美元有序回落。

随后数周内，各方出售约100亿美元美元。以现代标准衡量，这一规模并不算大；其力量在于信号。隔离式干预无法仅凭投资组合平衡效应持久推动汇率，其效力源于多个主权国家作出的可信公开承诺，而各方均为此承担声誉和财务成本。这种共同参与具有构成性，而非仅仅属于后勤协调，恰是单边稳定工具无法复制的东西。

事实证明，《广场协议》超额完成了目标：到1987年初，贸易加权美元较峰值下跌约40%，过度疲弱的美元取代原有矛盾成为新问题。1987年2月签订的《卢浮宫协议》则逆转目标，力求将美元跌势限制在非正式参考区间内。这一事件表明，维护均衡与促成修正存在结构性差异。

防守汇率需要持续实施隔离操作、长期管理流动性，并维持足以遏制投机的利率差，而每项措施都会给央行资产负债表带来直接成本。参与的央行共同吸收了这些成本，但两份公报均未说明由谁付费。

汇率操作在性质上近似财政行为，通过收入再分配和成本分摊发挥作用，与明确征税或公共支出十分相似。IMF研究人员指出，此类损失在权益缓冲充足的情况下由其承担，否则通过政府转移支付弥补；无论采用哪种方式，这些都属于财政成本。G-5凭借深厚的财政能力和隐含的相互担保机制，将这些成本社会化并分摊至各国财政。加纳则没有同等机制。

2022年至2025年，加纳央行完全独自承担了《广场协议》—《卢浮宫协议》模式中的修正与防守职能。它是在获得IMF 30亿美元扩展信贷安排的背景下，在加纳独立以来最严重的一次国内债务重组余波中，并在财政主导和结构性流动性过剩的历史遗留问题制约下完成这一任务的。

当发达经济体大幅收紧政策时，资本外逃和美元走强会对非洲货币施加贬值压力，推高输入性通胀，并扩大外币债务成本。塞地不具备日元和德国马克在20世纪80年代所拥有的储备货币地位，但《2002年加纳央行法》（第612号法）规定央行有义务维持价格稳定，并支持塞地走稳定发展的道路。因此，该行必须单独进行干预，以机构权益换取货币稳定。

蒙代尔—弗莱明三难定律认为，任何国家都无法同时实现固定汇率、资本自由流动和货币独立。Hélène Rey认为，全球金融周期将三难定律简化为两难困境，但两者都无法完整概括加纳央行的处境。该行面临的是四难困境，四项目标无法同时维持：

与国内债务交换计划（DDEP）相关的结构性流动性过剩，意味着由政策驱动的大额损失不仅极有可能发生，而且在算术上不可避免。加纳不是在无法兼得的三难定律各端之间作出选择，而是在试图同时占据三个彼此相邻的政策位置。损失正是这一过度约束体系化解矛盾的清算机制，资产负债表则充当最后吸收者。

令人悖论的是，公信力来自外部约束。IMF项目的一系列审查每次都要求在通胀、储备和财政目标方面达到特定标准，由此形成一种连续性的公信力机制，这是加纳央行单凭自身无法建立的。因此，对于缺乏G-5成员资格所赋予地缘政治资本的中央银行而言，作为替代性承诺工具的IMF项目条件，是多边协调在功能上最接近的等价物。它会消耗主权，但能够取得与协调干预质量相当的结果，即便实现机制不同。

账面亏损并非失败的同质化表现，而是由三种结构上不同的机制造成。第一种也是规模最大的一项，是公开市场操作（OMO）的成本，2025年达到167.3亿加纳塞地，接近2024年86.0亿加纳塞地的两倍。

最好将其理解为一种货币贡赋：一个已经因DDEP而扭曲的危机后金融体系，为收回危机时期货币融资所造成的过剩流动性而征收的代价。DDEP于2022年12月启动，要求国内债券持有人将现有证券置换为期限更长、收益率较低的债券。该计划对加纳央行所持资产造成约480亿加纳塞地减值，其中包括对非市场工具计提50%的折价，并在受影响工具到期前每年减少该行约130亿加纳塞地的利息收入。

重组还将商业银行流动性引导至加纳央行货币市场工具；在政策利率仍处高位之际，这些工具提供了颇具吸引力的短期回报。到2025年，OMO账面余额约为936亿加纳塞地，利率介于18%至28%之间。如果没有隔离操作，这些流动性将推高通胀和贬值压力，并逆转已经取得的成果。OMO账单正是不失去这些成果的代价。

第二项是黄金交易产生的90.5亿加纳塞地亏损，这是最容易被误解的组成部分。在加纳黄金局（GoldBod）协作下运行的国内黄金收购计划中，该行以塞地购买手工矿工和小规模矿工开采的本地黄金，并将其转换为储备。亏损产生的原因是，在购买时确认的塞地收购成本，高于黄金计入资产负债表时的账面价值。这属于时间错配，而非价值毁灭。到2025年末，该行仍持有约18.6吨黄金，价值约为归因于该计划亏损金额的三倍；该行还出售了约19吨黄金，并实现了利润。

这一计划的战略意义不止于积累储备。通过要求本地黄金出口前必须以塞地结算，加纳的黄金治理架构将外汇收入纳入官方渠道，减少非法资金流动，并为加纳央行干预提供持续的美元流动性来源。该计划在推动国际储备总额从91.1亿美元升至138.3亿美元方面发挥了关键作用。

第三项是升值悖论：加纳最值得称道的成就反而造成了巨额损失。当中央银行持有外国货币储备而本币升值时，这些储备的本币价值会机械性下降。持有10亿美元资产，在1美元兑17塞地时价值170亿加纳塞地，而在1美元兑10塞地时仅价值100亿加纳塞地。2025年，塞地升值在营业账户中造成54.7亿加纳塞地重估亏损，并在其他综合收益中造成193.2亿加纳塞地重估亏损。这是小型开放经济体央行资产负债表的结构性特征，而非政策错误。

《广场协议》之后，德国央行和日本银行也经历了同样的效应，因为它们出售美元，推高了德国马克和日元的价值。两者的经济实质在结构上完全相同，区别仅在于负担的分配方式。这种影响也是可逆的，正如行长Johnson Pandit Asiama所指出的那样。到2026年5月，塞地已从2025年财务报表采用的1美元兑10.4塞地水平走弱至约1美元兑11.5塞地，这体现了折算效应，而非储备的实际耗损。

加纳的经历远非独有。国际清算银行（BIS）已明确指出，亏损和负权益本身不会损害中央银行的运营能力。欧洲央行（ECB）2024年亏损79.4亿欧元，原因是在对银行准备金支付较高利息的同时，从遗留债券中获得的收益率较低；这一结构与加纳央行的OMO成本极为相似。欧洲央行将此类亏损结转，用未来利润弥补，并不存在补充资本的要求。

捷克国民银行（CNB）是加纳2025年处境最接近的先例。2013年11月至2017年4月，该行阻止捷克克朗兑欧元升值超过27捷克克朗，以避免通货紧缩，并大规模积累储备。取消汇率下限后，捷克克朗升值，其欧元资产的克朗价值下降，负权益持续多年，但其通胀目标职能并未受到任何损害。尽管捷克国民银行处于欧洲背景下，两者并非完全可比，但其经验可以移植：成功的汇率管理所造成的重估亏损，不会危及承担这些亏损的机构。

在其他地方，美联储将亏损作为递延资产计入未来向财政部的汇款，而英国财政部则补偿英格兰银行出售英国国债产生的亏损。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111500.title_zh: 政府加快住宅供应……首都圈全租市场供需仍不均衡
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111500.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者林基昌＝投身住房供应竞赛的政府最近将首尔全租及转租房源增长趋势列为市场稳定指标之一，但首都圈全租市场供需仍处于不容乐观的水平。据韩国不动产院15日公布的数据，以11月第二周为准，京畿地区全租供需指数为110.7，创下全租紧张问题严重的2021年8月第一周（111.3）以来的最高数值。该供需指数将需求与供应占比换算为分数，以100为基准，越接近200，意味着寻找房源的人越多于挂牌出租房源的人；越接近0，则情况相反。按京畿圈各区域来看，京釜1圈（果川、安阳、城南、军浦、义王）的全租供需为116.2，西海岸圈（富川、安山、始兴、光明、华城、乌山、平泽）为117.0，东部1圈（南杨州、구리、江南、光州）为111.7，全租供需均较为紧张。京畿圈（金浦、高阳、坡州）的全租供需指数虽在今年1月第一周降至91.1，供应一度超过需求，但到11月第二周又升至108.5，持续保持卖方占优趋势。即使是买卖价格上涨势头较弱的仁川，以11月第二周为准，其全租供需指数也达到110.4，需求超过供应的态势十分明显。首尔的全租供需指数今年7月第四周曾升至128.1，此后虽有所改善，但11月第二周仍达120.2，需求依然大幅超过供应。按区域来看，东北圈（城东、广进、东大门、中浪、城北江北、道峰、芦原）的刚需主要集中于中下层区域，买卖和全租价格涨势均较快，11月第二周全租供需指数为123.0；西南圈（杨천、江西、구로、金泉、永登浦、动作、冠岳）为125.9，全租供需失衡程度相对较高。Woori银行房地产研究员南赫宇表示：“由于新增全租流通房源很少，市场仅靠现有房源消化，郊区等地房源短缺，全租上涨压力较大。资金宽裕的租户可以从原居住地转向购房，但无法这样做的租赁需求则被挤向周边地区。”此前，政府13日在住房供应例行记者会上表示，首尔江南3区（瑞草、江南、松坡区）房价持续下跌、首尔平均涨幅放缓以及买卖交易减少等市场下行稳定指标正在扩大，同时将首尔公寓买卖及全租、转租房源增加列为积极指标。政府还强调，首尔及首都圈截至明年第一季度将有4万4千户家庭入住，包括3座新城市在内的新房销售也将持续推进，从而形成切实可见的供应。国土交通部有关负责人表示：“全租和转租房源确实增加了一部分，但与过去相比，并没有增加到那么高的水平。”他表示，将不折不扣地推进此前于9月发布的《住房稳定计划》所列全租和转租稳定措施。《住房稳定计划》内容包括：截至明年，首都圈将有约10万户公共销售、公共租赁等公益性住房入住，并通过长期公共租赁和民间租赁稳定租赁住宅市场。报道可通过KakaoTalk向okjebo提供。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习或应用。2026年11月15日08:05发布，2026年11月15日08时05分发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111313.title_zh: 韩国政府推动将4个中部地区学区拆分
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111313.body_zh: （议政府＝韩联社）记者金道允＝京畿道议政府教育支援厅正在推进一项方案，自2028学年度起，将市内初中划分为4个学区，为新生分配学校。然而，随着东部地区住宅开发项目陆续推进并吸引人口流入，学生人数增加，西部地区与各班额定人数之间出现了失衡问题。为此，议政府教育支援厅正在推进将市内初中划分为 가능、金오、松山、虎元4个学区，并在学区边界地区设置共同学区的方案。教育支援厅 explained称，通过此举，既可准备与应对学生人数减少相适应的合理班级数量和教师保障条件，也可根据学生人数增加情况制定适当的教师配置计划。教育支援厅将审议在10日至11日举行的家长说明会上提出的意见，补充完善学区划分方案，并计划于下月举行最终说明会。教育厅厅长金圭秀表示：“初中学校分配并非仅仅确定距离较近的学校，而是需要审视学生和家长的教育选择权、各校合理的班级规模、通勤条件与安全，以及校际教育环境均衡等重要教育政策。”报道请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习与利用。2026/11/15 08:00发稿，2026年11月15日08时00分发稿。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111500.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者尹宝兰=朝鲜15日对日本推进“禁止核物资进口例外”表示反对，并借此重申增强核武力的方针。朝鲜中央通讯社15日发表题为《日本鼓吹“非核三原则例外事项”很快将成为实现核野心的前奏》的评论称：“（日本的）危险挑衅行为要求我们凭借绝对优势更加坚决地维护地区和平与安全。”此前当地媒体报道称，日本政府正在研究年内拟修订的“三大安保文件”是否明列“非核三原则”的例外，实际上允许进口核武器。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111500.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 윤보람 기자 = 북한은 15일 일본이 '핵 반입 금지 예외'를 추진하는 것에 반발하며 이를 빌미로 핵무력 증강 방침을 재확인했다. 조선중앙통신은 15일 '일본이 기도하는 '비핵3원칙 예외사항'의 명기는 곧 핵야망 실현의 전주곡이다'란 제목의 논평을 내어 "(일본의) 위험천만한 작태는 우리로 하여금 절대적인 힘의 우세로 지역의 평화와 안전을 보다 억척으로 수호할 것을 요구하고 있다"고 밝혔다. 앞서 일본 정부가 연내 개정 예정인 '3대 안보 문서'에 '비핵 3원칙'의 예외를 명시해 핵무기 반입을 사실상 허용하는 방안을 검토한다는 사실이 현지 언론을 통해 알려졌다. 통신은 이에 대해 "곧 미국의 핵무기를 등에 업고 군사대국화의 야망을 실현하며 나아가서 자체핵 보유의 시초를 열어놓으려는 위험천만한 발상의 발현"이라고 지적했다. 그러면서 "'예외사항'이라는 것은 국내외의 비발치는 비난을 눅잦히면서도 '비핵3원칙'에 따른 금기조치들을 야금야금 허물어버리고 궁극에는 그 자체를 완전히 휴지장으로 만들어보려는 저들의 불순한 목적을 가리우기 위한 간교한 술책에 지나지 않는다"고 맹비난했다. 통신은 "보다 간과할 수 없는 것은 '국가안전보장전략'에 비핵3원칙의 예외사항을 명기하는 것과 동시에 안보 관련 문서들인 '국가방위전략'과 '방위력정비계획'에 방위비 증액과 핵잠수함 보유, 새로운 전투방식 도입 등 전쟁기계를 가동시키기 위한 조항들을 쪼아 박으려는 움직임이 입체적으로 벌어지고 있다는 사실"이라고 주장했다. 이어 "정의와 평화를 지향하는 국제사회는 지역과 세계의 안정에 파국적인 후과를 가져올 전범국 일본의 핵무장화 기도를 추호도 용납하지 말아야 한다"고 촉구했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/15 07:59 송고 2026년11월15일 07시59분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111500.title_zh: 朝鲜称日本推进“核物资进口禁令例外”是在“凭借绝对优势维护和平”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111500.body_zh:
（首尔＝韩联社）尹宝蓝记者＝朝鲜15日对日本推动设立“核武器禁止运入例外”表示反对，并借此重申增强核武力的方针。朝鲜中央通信社15日发表题为《日本鼓吹的“无核三原则例外事项”即将成为实现核野心的前奏》的评论称：“（日本的）危险挑衅行为要求我们凭借绝对的力量优势，更坚决地守护地区和平与安全。”

此前，日本当地媒体披露，日本政府正研究在年内计划修订的“三大安保文件”中明确列出“无核三原则”的例外，实际上允许核武器运入。通信社就此指出：“这是企图骑在美国核武器的肩头实现军事大国化野心，并为开启自身拥有核武器的先河而公然表现出的危险且荒谬的构想。”

通信社同时猛烈抨击道：“所谓‘例外事项’，不过是他们在国内外四处散布谴责、遭到强烈抵制的同时，依然企图逐项拆除依据‘无核三原则’实施的禁令，最终将其彻底化为废纸，以掩饰其险恶目的的一种狡猾伎计罢了。”

通信社主张：“更不容忽视的是，在‘国家安全保障战略’中明确列出无核三原则例外事项的同时，又在‘国家防卫战略’和‘防卫力整备计划’等安保文件中强行嵌入增加防卫费、拥有核潜艇、引入新作战方式等启动战争机器的相关条款，这一系列动作正立体化地展开。”

通信社继而呼吁：“以正义与和平为目标的国际社会，绝不能容忍日本这个会给地区和世界稳定带来灾难性后果的侵略国实现核武装。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.summary_zh: 曾任第8届参议院少数党副党鞭、三度担任代表巴耶尔萨中区的参议员 Emmanuel Paulker 宣布，他始终忠于人民民主党（PDP）。Paulker 在2007年至2019年间代表巴耶尔萨中区，并向该党成员保证，他致力于推动该党复兴。Turnah 在讲话中形容 Paulker 是人民民主党在巴耶尔萨州的创始支柱之一，并肯定了他对该党及该州政治发展的贡献。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.body: The former Deputy Minority Whip of the 8th Senate and three-time Senator representing Bayelsa Central, Senator Emmanuel Paulker, has declared his unwavering loyalty to the Peoples Democratic Party PDP). Speaking when he received members of the State Working Committee and other party leaders, led by the state chairman, Hon. Chief Alabh George Turnah, during a courtesy visit at his residence in Yenagoa, he reaffirmed his unbroken loyalty to the PDP and declared that he does not intend to leave the party. Paulker, who represented Bayelsa Central between 2007 and 2019, assured members of the party of his commitment to the resurgence of the party. “Since 1998, I have not left the PDP for even a second. I will not leave this party.” Paulker, while commending Turnah for his courageous and dynamic leadership of the party, assured him of his total commitment and support. He also urged the leadership to remain united, focused, carry all stakeholders along and pursue reconciliation despite internal challenges. “My doors are open to you at all times. Hold firm; the party is in safe hands under your leadership, and I am with you all the way.” Paulker expressed confidence that the PDP would emerge stronger and bounce back to power in the state. He enjoined leaders and members to remain committed to the party’s success, stressing that all the big names in Bayelsa politics started their politics from the PDP. Turnah, in his remarks, described Paulker as a founding pillar of the PDP in Bayelsa, acknowledging his contributions to the party and the state’s political development. He noted that Paulker’s experience, wisdom and guidance have remained a source of inspiration and strength to the current leadership of the Party in the State. Meanwhile, the leadership of the party has resolved to transfer full responsibility for the campaigns of its National Assembly candidates to the candidates themselves. A statement by the party’s publicity secretary, Ikaebimo Mark, stated that the leadership of the party will now concentrate its efforts on the statewide campaign for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu under the National Rainbow Coalition arrangement. Mark, who disclosed that the decision was taken at the regular meeting of the State Working Committee held on Thursday, 12th November 2026, added that it is in accordance with the directive of the party’s national leader, Nyesom Ezenwo Wike, issued in consultation with the National Working Committee of the Peoples Democratic Party. According to Mark, consequently, all National Assembly candidates are directed to take complete charge of their respective campaigns and to intensify community-to-community engagements across the state. He stated that the candidates are advised to proceed independently with their campaigns, as most have already been doing. Mark however noted that the party will, however, remain available to offer guidance and support whenever any National Assembly candidate seeks such assistance. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.title_zh: Paulker参议员宣布效忠PDP，该党在巴耶尔萨优先支持蒂努布竞选连任
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.body_zh: 第8届参议院前少数党党鞭、三度代表巴耶尔萨中区的参议员伊曼纽尔·保尔克已宣布对人民民主党（PDP）坚定不移的忠诚。在州主席阿巴夫·乔治·图纳阁下的带领下，州工作委员会成员及其他党内领导人于对其位于耶纳戈阿的住所进行礼节性拜访时，他发表讲话，重申自己对人民民主党的忠诚从未中断，并声明无意离开该党。保尔克在2007年至2019年间代表巴耶尔萨中央区，并向党内成员保证，他致力于推动该党东山再起。他说：“自1998年以来，我甚至一秒钟都没有离开过人民民主党。我不会离开这个党。”保尔克赞扬图纳以勇气和充满活力的方式领导该党，并保证将全力承诺和支持他。他还敦促党的领导层保持团结和专注，带动所有利益相关方，并在内部挑战面前推动和解。他说：“我的大门任何时候都向你们敞开。坚定信念；在你们的领导下，这个党掌握在可靠的手中，而我会始终与你们同在。”保尔克相信，人民民主党将变得更加强大，并在该州重掌权力。他告诫领导人和党员继续致力于推动该党成功，强调巴耶尔萨政界的所有大人物都是从人民民主党起步的。图纳在发言中称保尔克是人民民主党在巴耶尔萨的创始支柱之一，acknowledging他对该党和该州政治发展的贡献。他指出，保尔克的经验、智慧和指导始终是党内现任领导层从中汲取灵感和力量的源泉。与此同时，党的领导层决定，将全国议会候选人的竞选活动全部交由候选人 themselves负责。该党宣传秘书伊卡埃比莫·马克在一份声明中表示，党的领导层现在将集中精力开展全州范围的竞选活动，支持总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布在全国彩虹联盟框架下寻求连任。马克透露，这项决定是在2026年11月12日星期四举行的州工作委员会例会上作出的，符合该党全国领袖尼耶索姆·埃泽诺·威克在与人民民主党全国工作委员会磋商后发布的指示。马克表示 consequently，所有全国议会候选人均被要求全面负责各自的竞选活动，并加强在全州各社区之间的联系。他说，建议候选人独立推进各自的竞选活动，因为大多数人已经在这样做。不过，马克指出，如有任何全国议会候选人寻求协助，该党仍愿随时提供指导和支持。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地以及世界各地设有办公室。对于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层而言，它是通过所有平台获取尼日利亚最权威新闻资讯的媒体，同时充当抱负者和千禧一代的新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交叉地带。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://leadership.ng/energy-group-hails.title: Energy Group Hails Ojulari As AKK Pipeline Nears Completion
https://leadership.ng/energy-group-hails.summary: The group said the project, reportedly 95 per cent complete, could improve energy access, support businesses and stimulate economic activities across Northern Nigeria. The group further highlighted the pipeline’s potential to strengthen energy security in Northern Nigeria by reducing the dependence of industrial and power facilities in the region on gas transported over longer distances from the South.
https://leadership.ng/energy-group-hails.summary_zh: 该组织表示，据报道已完成95%的项目可改善能源获取、扶持企业，并推动尼日利亚北部各地的经济活动。该组织还强调，这条管道有望通过减少该地区工业和电力设施对从南部远距离运输天然气的依赖，加强尼日利亚北部的能源安全。
https://leadership.ng/energy-group-hails.body: The group said the project, reportedly 95 per cent complete, could improve energy access, support businesses and stimulate economic activities across Northern Nigeria. In a statement issued on Saturday, the initiative’s Executive Director, Dr Patrick Kwame, described the pipeline as a critical national infrastructure capable of translating Nigeria’s natural gas resources into tangible economic benefits for citizens. Kwame said the plan to commence gas delivery to Abuja before the end of 2026, followed by Kaduna and Kano in 2027, demonstrated a commitment to moving beyond project announcements to actual delivery. He said the project’s success should be measured by its impact on electricity generation, industrial production and household energy access. “Major infrastructure projects are ultimately judged by their impact on people’s lives, not simply by the amount of money invested or the length of pipelines constructed. “The AKK project has the potential to change how businesses operate, how electricity is generated and how households access energy. We commend Mr Bayo Ojulari for maintaining the focus required to bring this important national investment closer to completion,” the statement said. The group noted that reliable gas supply could improve power generation, support manufacturing, attract investments in industrial facilities and create employment opportunities. It added that expanding the pipeline’s distribution network could extend its benefits beyond major cities and industrial centres to more communities and commercial locations. The initiative also said improved gas infrastructure could support the expansion of compressed natural gas (CNG), providing transport operators with alternatives to petrol and diesel. According to Kwame, the project’s benefits to ordinary Nigerians would include more reliable electricity, reduced energy costs for businesses, employment opportunities and wider energy choices. He said lower energy costs could enable manufacturers to operate more efficiently, with positive effects on workers, suppliers and consumers. The group further highlighted the pipeline’s potential to strengthen energy security in Northern Nigeria by reducing the dependence of industrial and power facilities in the region on gas transported over longer distances from the South. The 614-kilometre AKK pipeline is a 40-inch gas transmission system designed to transport natural gas from Ajaokuta in Kogi State through Abuja and Kaduna to Kano, connecting major economic and industrial centres along its route. The initiative also welcomed NNPC’s reported $1.5 billion financing secured against projected pipeline throughput, describing it as evidence of the potential of commercially viable infrastructure to attract investment. However, it stressed that completing the main pipeline must be followed by the development of distribution networks and facilities required to deliver gas to end-users. It urged NNPC to sustain its commitment to project execution, transparency and accountability to ensure that businesses and communities benefit from the infrastructure. “The remaining work must receive the same level of attention and urgency that has brought the project to its present stage. “A completed transmission pipeline must translate into actual gas supply for power plants, factories and other users,” the statement added. The group called on government institutions, investors and industry stakeholders to support the project’s completion and the development of additional connections to underserved communities. https://leadership.ng/energy-group-hails.body_zh: 该组织表示，据报道已完成95%的项目能够改善尼日利亚北部地区的能源可及性、支持企业并刺激经济活动。周六发布的一份声明称，该项目执行主任帕特里克·夸梅博士将这条管道描述为关键国家基础设施，能够把尼日利亚的天然气资源转化为惠及公民的实际经济效益。夸梅表示，计划在2026年底前开始向阿布贾输送天然气，并于2027年延伸至卡杜纳和卡诺，这表明政府正致力于从发布项目公告迈向实际供气。他说，应当根据该项目对发电、工业生产和家庭能源可及性的影响来衡量其成败。声明称：“大型基础设施项目最终应以其对人们生活的影响来评判，而不能仅仅看投入了多少钱或修建了多长的管道。AKK项目有可能改变企业的运营方式、发电方式以及家庭获取能源的方式。我们赞扬Bayo Ojulari先生始终保持重点，推动这项重要的国家投资进一步接近完工。”该组织指出，稳定可靠的天然气供应可以改善电力生产、支持制造业、吸引对工业设施的投资并创造就业机会。它补充说，扩展管道配送网络可以让其惠及范围从主要城市和工业中心延伸至更多社区和商业地点。该项目还表示，改进天然气基础设施能够支持压缩天然气（CNG）的发展，为运输运营商提供汽油和柴油以外的替代选择。夸梅称，该项目给普通尼日利亚人带来的好处将包括更可靠的电力、更低的企业能源成本、就业机会和更多样的能源选择。他说，降低能源成本能够提高制造商的运营效率，并对工人、供应商和消费者产生积极影响。该组织进一步强调，这条管道有可能通过减少尼日利亚北部工业和电力设施对从南部经长距离运输的天然气的依赖，加强该地区的能源安全。全长614公里的AKK管道是一套40英寸天然气输送系统，设计用途是从科吉州阿贾奥库塔经阿布贾和卡杜纳向卡诺输送天然气，连接沿线主要经济和工业中心。该项目还欢迎尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）据称以管道预计输气量为依据获得了15亿美元融资，并将其视为具有商业可行性的基础设施能够吸引投资的证明。然而，该组织强调，主管道完工后，必须继续建设向终端用户输送天然气所需的配送网络和设施。它敦促NNPC继续履行对项目执行、透明度的问责承诺，确保企业和社区从这项基础设施中受益。声明补充道：“剩余工程必须得到与推动项目达到目前阶段同等重视和紧迫的推进。一条建成的输气管道必须转化为向电厂、工厂和其他用户实际输送天然气。”该组织呼吁政府机构、投资者和行业利益相关方支持项目完工，并支持为服务不足的社区建设更多连接设施。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、突发独家内幕和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，即时掌握全天候最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary: Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Dr Kingsley Udeh, on Saturday officially inaugurated a political support group, As Tinubu and Mbah Move (ATM), to mobilise support for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, Enugu State Governor Peter Mbah and other All Progressives Congress (APC) candidates in the 2027 general elections.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary_zh: 创新、科学与技术部长金斯利·乌德博士于星期六正式为一个政治支持团体“提努巴与姆巴行动”（ATM）揭牌，以动员支持总统博拉·艾哈迈德·提努巴、埃努古州州长彼得·姆巴以及其他全进步大会党候选人参加2027年大选。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Dr Kingsley Udeh, on Saturday officially inaugurated a political support group, As Tinubu and Mbah Move (ATM), to mobilise support for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, Enugu State Governor Peter Mbah and other All Progressives Congress (APC) candidates in the 2027 general elections. The group, which is anchored on technology and innovation, is expected to deploy digital tools to mobilise voters, monitor grassroots engagement and track its membership and electoral mobilisation activities across the 4,145 polling units in Enugu State. Speaking at the inauguration, Governor Mbah commended Udeh for the initiative, describing its technological approach and grassroots mobilisation strategy as important complements to the existing political structures of the APC in the state. Mbah, who expressed excitement over the large turnout at the event, urged members of the group to extend the enthusiasm generated by the inauguration to communities, villages, kindreds, families and polling units across the state. He said the support group’s effectiveness would be measured not by the crowd at its inauguration but by its ability to translate the energy into grassroots mobilisation and electoral support. “ATM, this heat, this energy must go beyond this inauguration hall. You must take this energy to our streets, villages, polling units, kindreds and families,” he said. The governor urged members to convince voters through visible development projects and the achievements of his administration, including Smart Green Schools, the International Conference Centre, Presidential Hotel, International Hospital and other infrastructure projects. On President Tinubu’s re-election bid, Mbah described the President as a unifier, arguing that his administration’s economic reforms and infrastructure investments had laid the foundation for national growth and shared prosperity. He said the President’s decision to remove fuel subsidy and unify the foreign exchange regime demonstrated the political courage required to address longstanding structural challenges in the Nigerian economy. According to him, although the reforms initially imposed difficulties on citizens, they were necessary to restore macroeconomic stability, rebuild confidence in the economy and attract private capital and foreign investment. Mbah argued that sustained economic reforms were necessary to translate the emerging growth trajectory into employment opportunities and improved living conditions for Nigerians. He also highlighted the Federal Government’s infrastructure interventions in the South-East, particularly the improved Enugu-Onitsha highway, the ongoing Enugu-Port Harcourt Expressway project and the concessioning of the Akanu Ibiam International Airport. The governor said the airport concession would strengthen the South-East’s economic competitiveness, particularly with the planned commencement of cargo operations and direct flights between Enugu and Guangzhou, China, before the end of the first quarter of 2027. He maintained that the region stood to benefit significantly from the expansion of its aviation and cargo-handling capacity, given the volume of goods currently transported by road from Lagos to the South-East. On the political implications of the 2027 elections, Mbah urged the people of the South-East to adopt a strategic approach to national politics, stressing the importance of building political alliances beyond the region. He recalled the political alignments of the First and Second Republics, particularly the alliances involving Dr Nnamdi Azikiwe and Dr Michael Okpara, as examples of how political cooperation across regional boundaries could advance the interests of the Igbo. The governor argued that supporting Tinubu’s re-election would provide the South-East with an opportunity to strengthen its political relevance and deepen its participation in national governance. He cautioned APC members against complacency, despite the party’s dominance of the state’s political structures, urging them to campaign vigorously as though they were the underdogs. Mbah disclosed that the group would complement the party’s existing structures across the state’s 4,145 polling units, adding that its digital monitoring platform would provide a verifiable picture of grassroots mobilisation. He also urged eligible voters who had yet to collect their Permanent Voter Cards (PVCs) to do so and mobilise for the January 16, 2027, presidential and National Assembly elections, as well as the February 6, 2027, governorship and State Assembly polls. The governor, however, stressed that the administration’s development agenda remained a work in progress, noting that the presence of poverty, inadequate electricity supply, water challenges and unpaved roads in some communities meant that more work was required. Earlier, the convener of ATM, Dr Udeh, said the support group was different from conventional political organisations because of its reliance on technology, innovation and a data-driven approach to electoral mobilisation. He disclosed that the group had established an innovation situation room and digital dashboard to monitor membership registration, grassroots activities and voter mobilisation across polling units. According to him, membership registration would be tied to the possession of a PVC and the submission of voters’ identification details through a dedicated online portal, while the platform would also track referrals and recruitment of new members. Udeh said the initiative was designed to replace unverified membership claims with a credible database that would enable the group to measure its performance and provide verifiable reports. He added that Governor Mbah would have direct access to the dashboard to monitor activities, verify membership figures and assess the group’s progress. Describing the initiative as an expression of appreciation and loyalty to the governor, Udeh said the relationship between the group and Mbah went beyond the 2027 electioneering season. He pledged that ATM would deliver measurable results in support of APC candidates at all elective levels, particularly President Tinubu. Also speaking, the APC National Vice Chairman, South-East Zone, Dr Ijeomah Arodiogbu, commended Governor Mbah for his developmental strides in Enugu State and his efforts in coordinating the party’s presidential campaign activities in the South-East. Arodiogbu also praised Udeh for establishing the support group and his contributions to the Federal Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology. He called on the people of the South-East to support Tinubu’s re-election, while urging the people of Enugu State to vote for Mbah and all APC candidates in the 2027 elections. Using an apprenticeship analogy, the APC chieftain said no responsible father would send his son to learn a trade under a master who would not settle him after completing his apprenticeship. He argued that the South-East should support Tinubu because, according to him, the President understood the importance of rewarding loyalty and political support. Also speaking, the Enugu State Coordinator of ATM, Ugwuoke Onyebuchi, said the group comprised largely individuals who had previously been active in civil society rather than partisan politics. He said their decision to mobilise support for Mbah and Tinubu was informed by the confidence reposed in Udeh and their conviction that they could contribute to the state’s political and developmental direction. Ugwuoke said members would embark on grassroots mobilisation, voter education and engagement to persuade residents to support the APC candidates in the forthcoming elections. He added that the group would deploy technology and data-driven strategies to identify, classify and engage voters across communities, insisting that its activities and results would be measurable. The highlight of the event was the swearing-in of ATM members and executives at the state and local government levels by the Enugu State Commissioner for Youth and Sports, Barr. Lloyd Ekweremadu. The event was attended by the APC National Vice Chairman, South-East Zone, Dr Ijeomah Arodiogbu; former members of the House of Representatives, Hon U.S.A Igwesi, who is also the Enugu State Coordinator of Renewed Hope Ambassadors of Nigeria, and Hon Ogbuefi Ozomgbachi, Deputy Coordinator of the Presidential Campaign Council in the South-East. Others included the Chairman of the Enugu State Traditional Rulers Council, HRM Igwe Ikechukwu Asadu; local government chairmen; members of the Enugu State Executive Council; the state Chairman of the APC, Dr Martin Chukwunwike; and the APC South-East Women Leader, Dr Oby Ajih
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: 2027年：Udeh为蒂努布、Mbah及其他APC候选人成立ATM支持团体
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 创新、科学与技术部长 Kingsley Udeh 博士于星期六正式为政治支持组织“随 Tinubu 和 Mbah 前进”（ATM）揭牌。该组织旨在动员支持总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu 竞选连任、恩古州州长 Peter Mbah 连任，以及进步大会党（APC）其他候选人在2027年大选中参选。这个以技术和创新为支柱的组织预计将利用数字工具动员选民、监测基层参与情况，并跟踪其在恩古州4,145个投票点的会员招募及选举动员活动。Mbah 州长在揭牌仪式上赞扬 Udeh 发起这一组织，称其技术路径和基层动员战略是 APC 现有政治体系在州内的重要补充。Mbah 对活动上人数众多感到兴奋，并敦促该组织成员把揭牌活动激发的热情延伸到全州各个社区、村庄、宗族、家庭和投票点。他说，支持组织是否有效，不能以揭牌仪式上的 crowds 人数衡量，而要看其能否将这股热情转化为基层动员和选举支持。他说：“ATM，这份热度、这股能量必须走出这间揭牌大厅。你们必须把这种能量带到我们的街道、村庄、投票点、宗族和家庭。”州长敦促组织成员通过看得见的发展项目及其政府的成就说服选民，包括智慧绿色学校、国际会议中心、总统酒店、国际医院及其他基础设施项目。谈及总统 Tinubu 寻求连任，Mbah 称总统是一位团结者，认为其政府的经济改革和基础设施投资为全国经济增长和共同繁荣奠定了基础。他说，总统取消燃油补贴并统一外汇制度的决定，展示了解决尼日利亚经济长期结构性挑战所需的政治勇气。据他介绍，尽管这些改革初期给民众带来困难，但它们是恢复宏观经济稳定、重建经济信心以及吸引私人资本和外国投资所必需的。Mbah 认为，持续推进经济改革对于把新出现的增长轨迹转化为就业机会、改善尼日利亚民众生活条件至关重要。他还强调联邦政府在东南部的基础设施建设，尤其是改善后的恩古—奥尼沙公路、正在推进的恩古—哈科特港高速公路项目，以及 Akanu Ibiam 国际机场的特许经营权转让。州长表示，机场特许经营将增强东南部的经济竞争力，尤其是在计划于2027年第一季度末前启动货运业务以及恩古与中国广州之间直飞航班之后。他坚持认为，鉴于目前从拉各斯经公路运往东南部的货物数量，该地区将显著受益于航空和货运处理能力的扩张。谈及2027年大选的政治影响，Mbah 敦促东南部民众采取战略性方式参与国家政治，强调在地区之外建立政治联盟的重要性。他回顾了第一共和国和第二共和国时期的政治联盟，特别是涉及 Nnamdi Azikiwe 博士和 Michael Okpara 博士的联盟，并将其作为跨地区政治合作如何推进伊博人利益的实例。州长认为，支持 Tinubu 寻求连任将为东南部提供加强自身政治影响力并深化参与国家治理的机会。尽管 APC 在该州政治体系中占据主导地位，Mbah 仍告诫该党成员不要自满，要求他们像处于劣势的一方那样积极竞选。Mbah 表示，该组织将与该州4,145个投票点的现有党组织体系形成互补，其数字监测平台将提供可核实基层动员情况的图景。他还敦促尚未领取永久选民卡（PVC）的合格选民及时领取，并为2027年1月16日的总统和国民议会选举以及2027年2月6日的州长和州议会选举开展动员。不过，州长强调政府的发展议程仍在推进之中，并指出贫困、供电不足、用水难题以及部分社区道路未铺装等问题意味着仍需开展更多工作。此前，ATM 召集人 Udeh 博士表示，由于该支持组织依靠技术、创新和数据驱动的选举动员方式，因此不同于传统政治组织。他透露，该组织已设立创新作战室和数字仪表板，用于监测会员登记、基层活动和投票点内的选民动员情况。据他介绍，会员登记将与持有 PVC 以及通过专门在线门户提交选民身份信息相联系，平台还将跟踪推荐和招募新会员的情况。Udeh 称，该项举措旨在用一个可信数据库取代未经核实的会员声明，使组织能够衡量自身表现并提供可核实报告。他还表示，Mbah 州长将可直接访问该仪表板，以监测活动、核实会员人数并评估组织进展。Udeh 将这项举措描述为对州长的感谢和忠诚，并称该组织与 Mbah 的关系超越了2027年选举竞选期。他承诺 ATM 将在各级选举中支持 APC 候选人，尤其是总统 Tinubu，并取得可衡量的成果。APC 东南部全国副主席 Ijeomah Arodiogbu 博士也在仪式上发言，赞扬 Mbah 州长在恩古州取得的发展成就，以及他在协调该党东南部总统竞选活动方面所做的努力。Arodiogbu 还赞扬 Udeh 成立支持组织，并对其在联邦创新、科学与技术部作出的贡献表示肯定。他呼吁东南部民众支持 Tinubu 寻求连任，同时敦促恩古州民众在2027年大选中投票支持 Mbah 和所有 APC 候选人。这位 APC 领导人以学徒制作比喻称，没有哪位负责任的父亲会把儿子送去跟随一位师傅学艺，却在儿子学成后不为其谋职安排。他 arguing 认为，东南部应支持 Tinubu，因为据他所说，总统懂得奖赏忠诚和政治支持的重要性。ATM 恩古州协调员 Ugwuoke Onyebuchi 也在仪式上表示，该组织主要由此前活跃于公民社会而非党派政治的人士组成。他说，他们决定动员支持 Mbah 和 Tinubu，是因为信任 Udeh，并坚信自己能够为州的政治和发展方向作出贡献。Ugwuoke 表示，成员将开展基层动员、选民教育和沟通工作，说服居民在即将举行的选举中支持 APC 候选人。他还表示，该组织将采用技术和数据驱动战略识别、分类并联系各个社区的选民，坚持其活动成果都可以衡量。活动的高潮是由恩古州青年与体育专员 Barr. Lloyd Ekweremadu 为 ATM 州级和地方政府层级的成员及执行人员主持宣誓就职。出席活动者包括 APC 东南部全国副主席 Ijeomah Arodiogbu 博士；尼日利亚众议院前议员、恩古州“ renewed hope ambassadors”协调员 U.S.A Igwesi 阁下，以及总统竞选委员会东南部副协调员 Ogbuefi Ozomgbachi 阁下。其他出席者还包括恩古州传统统治者委员会主席 HRM Igwe Ikechukwu Asadu；地方政府主席；恩古州执行委员会成员；APC 州主席 Martin Chukwunwike 博士；以及 APC 东南部妇女领袖 Oby Ajih 博士。
